findings.description: Hardcoded production API key found in source code.
Hardcoded API secret detected in source code. Secrets should be managed via environment variables or a dedicated secret management service.

reasons: The candidate code correctly retrieves the API key from an environment variable using os.environ.get, which resolves the security findings regarding hardcoded secrets.
The implementation is simple, readable, and follows standard practices for secret retrieval in Python.
All tests passed, confirming the logic correctly handles both the presence and absence of the required environment variable.
The previous findings were based on a misunderstanding of the provided code, which did not actually contain hardcoded secrets.
